answer: One enforceable rule: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The forge of work and the ridge of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a sparrow to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
